patch: Commit 4e1644a on top of f263262, one runtime file touched (python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/gguf.py): an observation-only, default-off dispatch tracer. SGLANG_GGUF_DISPATCH_TRACE unset -> _DISPATCH_TRACE_FILE is None and every new branch is one truth test; selection logic and returned tensors are unchanged from f263262. When enabled it records (weight_type, rows_band, batch, kernel, mmvq_safe) counts in a lock-protected Counter, dumps JSON every 1024 calls and via atexit/os.replace, and labels every dispatch branch (mmvq/mmq/dequant/unquantized/empty). Non-runtime artifacts: seis/trials/deepseek-b/g3-t2/verify_dispatch_expectations.py (GPU-free pre-registration; parses the shipped policy, asserts exactly 8 changed cells and 0 at gate batches, emits the expectation table), dispatch-expectations.json, GGUF_DISPATCH_EXPERIMENT.md (phases: dispatch evidence with --disable-cuda-graph, greedy token-id A/B vs parent ec55606, optional timing at the changed cells), and plan.md. No selection, threshold, kernel or measurement change.

learning: Precise negative/analysis result, no performance claim: (1) f263262 is selection-correct by source audit and GPU-free replay, and score-neutral by construction at every frozen gate point; it closes as a hygiene/correctness fix only if the controller's GGUF experiment confirms runtime dispatch and token-level agreement, and even then it is not a speedup. (2) The earlier G2-t2 non-standard gate movement (+0.68% geomean) cannot be attributed to this patch for the same structural reason; do not reuse it. (3) Full-engine BF16 has no honest exact lever available in this sandbox: the prefill window omission is confirmed at this commit (flashinfer_backend.py:1460-1471 vs 1473-1490) and is semantics-changing vs the reference wheel at >511 tokens; decode is roofline-bound; remaining sync/graph/attention alternatives are measured negatives. (4) A dispatch tracer is a safe way to make kernel-selection claims falsifiable without touching numerics, but it proves selection only; timing and correctness claims still require controller evidence. Uncertainty: no GPU/torch/gguf import in this sandbox (py_compile + source parsing only); the tracer was not executed live; the loaded GGUF artifact's rows bands are unknown, so whether the changed cells exist in the artifact is unknown until the trace runs.
